description: Return the checklist to run on a finished page or component built with AI Canvas parts: install completeness, prop correctness (via validate_usage), both themes, layout at 320px, motion cleanup and reduced motion, keyboard and contrast, and composition rules. scope.description: "page" (default) for a composed screen, "component" for a single adapted or hand-built component.
